entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: json #64546
  • blazor.web.js is no longer delivered in a Library project #64545
  • [Identity] Support for the digital credentials API in Identity for user verification and account recovery #64544
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Blazor WebAssembly fingerprint not applied in certain publish scenarios #64543
    Backlog
  • Navigation Manager ignores ExcludeFromInteractiveRouting attribute #64541
    Backlog
  • Blazor: One-way binding with automatic expression #64538
    Backlog
  • Add example showing use of source-generated logging in minimal-API templates #64537
  • [OpenAPI] XML comment for parameter is not found when operation parameter name doesn't match the action parameter name #64534

Closed

  • Enabling JS root components breaks circuit reinitialization #64523
    .NET 11 Planning
  • .NET 10 Blazor navigation from wasm to interactive server broken #64472
    10.0.x
  • QueryStringRequestCultureProvider does not work with @rendermode InteractiveServer #64420
  • .Net 10 Blazor Enhanced Navigation in WASM fails due to no PageTitle #64522
    10.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • [Blazor] Support NavigateTo when enhanced nav is disabled (#52267) #64542
    area-blazor
  • Refactor param binding failure handling in RequestDelegate #64539
    community-contribution, feature-rdg, area-networking
  • Respect IModelNameProvider when matching OpenAPI parameters #64535
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi
  • Fix post actions for Razor Class Library template #64532
    area-mvc, feature-templates, feature-blazor-template-engine

Merged

  • Allow JS root components to reinitialize on circuit restart #64536
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview1
  • [Blazor] Fix metadata comments incorrectly being processed as logical elements #64529
    area-blazor, 11.0-preview1
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64531
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 11.0-preview1

Updated

  • feat: "Spanify" DataProtector with IBufferWriter<byte> #64262
    area-dataprotection, pending-ci-rerun
  • OpenAPI: Fix duplicate xml documentation ids for Generic properties and references #64404
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, pending-ci-rerun, area-minimal
  • Fix empty render of the ErrorBoundary #64526
    area-blazor
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #64433
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
